## Summary

Accurate forecasts of oil and gas export values help economic planning. This study compares two forecasting approaches — the classical SARIMA model and the deep-learning LSTM network — for predicting Indonesian oil & gas export values.

## Contribution

- Systematic comparison of SARIMA vs LSTM on macroeconomic time series.
- Practical guidance on when classical vs deep-learning forecasting is preferable.
- Published in *SATESI: Jurnal Sains Teknologi dan Sistem Informasi* 5(1), 69–79.

## Keywords

SARIMA · LSTM · Time-Series Forecasting · Export Prediction · Machine Learning
